model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A dark blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “Llama-3B” and begins at approximately 0.38 when the number of completions is 2⁰, increasing to approximately 0.78 when the number of completions is 2⁸. A dark green dashed line, marked with square data points, represents “Llama-3B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.32 at 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.72 at 2⁸. A light blue line, marked with triangular data points, represents “Llama-1B”, beginning at approximately 0.26 at 2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.68 at 2⁸. Finally, a light green dashed line, marked with diamond data points, represents “Llama-1B + FT”, starting at approximately 0.22 at 2⁰ and rising to approximately 0.62 at 2⁸.
